defects.exactReviewFinding: The generated exit cannot consume the controller's ENTRY_RECEIPT.json envelope because the generator ignores envelope.entry; R3 local replay supplied a different bare shape.
defects.executableFailure: A successful controller run cannot materialize the exact exit transaction, so the gate cannot be removed through the documented path.
defects.rootCause: Producer and consumer use incompatible JSON contracts and the replay bypasses the producer envelope.
defects.r4AcceptanceCondition: The exit generator accepts only the schema-validated R4 controller envelope, local replay passes that exact envelope, comparator failure blocks exit, and post-exit failure returns HOLD.
defects.r4Repair: Use one R4 entry-envelope schema from capture through exit generation and invoke exit/post-exit only from the controller's fail-closed state machine.
defects.localValidation: Generate an R4 envelope from raw entry/proof fixtures, materialize exit SQL from it, reject malformed envelopes, and prove UNKNOWN/comparator-failure states cannot exit.

defects.exactReviewFinding: The workdir guard proves two candidate hashes and an 87-file shape but does not authenticate the full manifest; another unapplied lower-version migration can be substituted and --include-all can apply a third migration.
defects.executableFailure: The future apply can discover more than the exact frozen pair while the R3 guard still passes.
defects.rootCause: The workdir mixes 85 historical files with pending files and validates only count/tail position rather than exact pending-set equality.
defects.r4AcceptanceCondition: The hermetic workdir contains exactly two SQL files with exact names, sizes, paths, hashes, and no seed/roles/helper SQL; a target-explicit dry-run proposes exactly that ordered pair before quiescence.
defects.r4Repair: Build a new minimal Supabase project exposing only the frozen pair, emit a complete inventory receipt, hard-fail any extra SQL, and validate the dry-run JSON set before entry.
defects.localValidation: Build and inventory a disposable workdir, inject a third migration and require hard failure, and validate exact-pair versus extra-plan fixtures.

defects.exactReviewFinding: Monitor and immediate-proof outputs are captured but not required, cadence gaps are not measured, monitor SQL cannot pin full gate/invariant identity, immediate proof ignores ledger/HTTP drift, and ambiguous client exit performs no server-state adjudication.
defects.executableFailure: Failed, late, or mismatched monitoring and proof can coexist with progression; timeout/client ambiguity cannot distinguish no apply, partial apply, complete apply, or active backend.
defects.rootCause: R3 has evidence capture without one enforcing orchestration/state-classification contract.
defects.r4AcceptanceCondition: One controller uses one monotonic origin and immutable deadlines, schedules T+5n samples, parses and enforces every proof/monitor/comparator, escalates fail-closed at 600 seconds, and invokes a read-only classifier for every ambiguous outcome with no blind retry.
defects.r4Repair: Replace capture-only orchestration with an anchored scheduler, exact proof comparators, executable state matrix, server adjudicator, controller-generated entry/final receipts, and recursive evidence manifest.
defects.localValidation: Exercise cadence/missed-slot logic, timeout UNKNOWN, four ledger classifications, 600-second escalation, comparator failure, exit eligibility, entry receipt generation, and manifest generation in disposable fixtures.
